channel.title: Remote Yoga Coach, Blog
channel.description: Practical wellbeing for distributed teams: burnout prevention, workplace mindfulness, chair yoga and honest advice on corporate wellbeing that gets used.

item.title: Naturaförmån: så kan hela teamet få yoga och mindfulness, utan att röra friskvårdsbidraget
item.description: De flesta känner till friskvårdsbidraget och dess tak på 5 000 kr. Färre känner till naturaförmån, det andra sättet att erbjuda friskvård, utan samma gräns och utan att röra någons personliga budget.

item.title: Kontorsyoga på distans: vad det är och hur det funkar för svenska team
item.description: Vad är stolyoga eller kontorsyoga på distans egentligen, och hur går det till i praktiken via Teams? En enkel förklaring för team som är nyfikna men osäkra.

item.title: Why wellbeing programme attendance drops, and how to fix it
item.description: Wellbeing programme attendance rarely falls because people stop caring. It usually comes down to friction: an inconsistent slot, a format that does not suit everyone, or no visible sign that joining is genuinely fine. Here is how to fix it.

item.title: Hybridarbete och psykisk hälsa: så håller du teamet friskt på distans
item.description: Tidiga tecken på att ett hybrid- eller distansteam börjar gå på knäna, varför punktinsatser sällan hjälper, och en enkel återkommande vana som faktiskt gör skillnad.

item.title: How to build wellbeing into remote employee onboarding
item.description: Most remote onboarding checklists cover laptops and logins but skip wellbeing entirely. Here is how to fold a wellbeing habit into a new starter's first weeks, without adding another task to their list.

item.title: Meditation, breathing or chair yoga: which class should your team book?
item.description: Meditation, breathing and chair yoga are three separate class types, not one blended session. Here is how I help HR and people leaders pick the right one, or mix all three.

item.title: How to measure the ROI of a team wellbeing programme
item.description: A practical way to measure whether a team wellbeing programme is working, using attendance and a wellbeing check you can actually trust, without inventing a return figure.

item.title: Corporate wellness ideas that actually work for remote and hybrid teams
item.description: Most remote wellness ideas lists are full of things nobody does twice. What actually drives participation for distributed teams, and how to tell the difference.

item.title: How to improve morale on a remote team
item.description: What builds morale and a strong, connected remote team: being seen, shared rituals, realistic workloads and honest recognition, not perks or forced fun.

item.title: How to start a corporate wellbeing programme: a practical guide for HR
item.description: A practical, step-by-step guide to starting a corporate wellbeing programme from scratch. How to set up an employee wellbeing programme that people actually use, built on one consistent habit rather than a scattering of perks.

item.title: Corporate wellbeing for tech teams
item.description: Tech and startup teams burn out quietly long before anyone says so. Here is why builder culture is prone to it, and what a recurring live reset actually changes.

item.title: Virtual wellbeing lunch and learn ideas for remote teams
item.description: Practical virtual lunch and learn ideas for remote teams. Why the usual talking-head webinar falls flat, and what a genuinely restorative wellbeing session looks like.

item.title: Manager burnout: the signs, and how to protect your team from it
item.description: Managers burn out quietly and often last. The signs of manager burnout to watch for in yourself and in a manager you lead, why it cascades to the team, and practical, non-heroic habits that help.

item.title: Employee wellbeing ideas on a small budget
item.description: Practical, low-cost employee wellbeing ideas that actually work, plus the one paid option that keeps per-person cost low as your team grows.

item.title: Calm and Headspace for Business vs live sessions: which does your team actually use?
item.description: A fair Calm for Business and Headspace for Work alternative comparison. Great apps, but a library only helps those who open it. Why a live session wins on use.

item.title: Tech neck exercises: neck and shoulder stretches
item.description: Gentle neck and shoulder stretches to undo tech neck from desk and screen work. What causes it, seven seated exercises, and the setup fix. No equipment needed.

item.title: Office yoga for remote and hybrid teams: what it actually is
item.description: Office yoga and workplace yoga are umbrella terms for yoga done during the workday, wherever your team sits. Here is what a live, on-screen session actually looks like.

item.title: How to keep a hybrid team focused and connected
item.description: Hybrid teams lose focus and connection in the gaps between office and home. Here are practical habits a manager can put in place, and one shared weekly anchor that reaches everyone equally.

item.title: How to meditate at work: a 5-minute desk meditation
item.description: A 5-minute desk meditation for the gap between meetings: no app, camera off, step by step for beginners, plus how to keep it up on busy days.

item.title: Do workplace wellness apps actually work? What the engagement data says
item.description: Wellbeing apps look like an easy win, but the engagement numbers tell a harder story. What the data shows, and what works better for distributed teams.

item.title: Breathing exercises for work stress: 4 techniques for your next meeting
item.description: Four simple breathing exercises you can do at your desk, before a meeting, a presentation or a difficult call, to steady your nerves in under two minutes.

item.title: How to run a wellbeing session over Teams (or Zoom)
item.description: A practical guide to running a virtual wellbeing session for a remote team over Teams or Zoom: setup, the session arc, getting people to show up, and the norms that make it work.

item.title: Team wellbeing subscription vs one-off workshops: which actually works?
item.description: One-off wellbeing workshops feel efficient but fade fast. Here is how a team wellbeing subscription compares on results and cost, and when a one-off still makes sense.

item.title: Corporate mindfulness sessions: what to actually expect
item.description: What a corporate mindfulness session actually involves, what happens in one, how often to run them, and how to tell if it is working. A plain guide for HR and people leaders.

item.title: How to prevent burnout in a distributed team
item.description: Burnout hides in distributed teams. How to recognise the warning signs remotely, what does not work, and the preventive habits that actually help, for managers and HR.

item.title: Chair yoga at your desk in 5 minutes
item.description: 8 gentle chair yoga poses you can do at your desk in 5 minutes, between calls. No mat, no changing, camera off. Eases tense shoulders and a stiff back.

item.title: Office yoga prices 2026: what corporate yoga costs
item.description: What office yoga prices look like in 2026: per session, per month and per employee, online or in person, so you can budget before you ask.
